description: Rank consumer products by national WEIGHTED emergency-department injury estimate for one year — "what injures people the most", "top products by ER visits", "most dangerous household products". Backed by the same CPSC NEISS national-estimate methodology as neiss_injuries (summed statistical weight, not raw case counts). Optionally narrow by age_range, e.g. age_range="0-4" for products that injure young children most.

year.description: Calendar year. Default: the most recent year loaded (the response says which).

name: neiss_top_products
title: Neiss Top Products
